title: SS officers, Freemasons and occultists running NASA

tellings.quote: So, by the mid-1960s, the structure of NASA, and I mean the actual power structure, was a strange cocktail of former SS officers, Freemasons, and occultists.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that by the mid-1960s the real power structure of NASA, the US space agency, was "a strange cocktail" of former SS officers, meaning members of Nazi Germany's elite force, along with Freemasons, a fraternal society with private rituals, and people drawn to the occult. He names figures such as John Glenn, Buzz Aldrin, James Webb, Kenneth Kleinknecht, Edgar Mitchell and James Irwin. If true, it would mean the space program was steered by hidden beliefs and loyalties.
